summary: frontend-orb ships obfuscated preinstall dropper that downloads Bun to execute a bundled opaque payload
details: package.json declares a preinstall lifecycle hook `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is obfuscated with `_0x...` identifiers and, on `npm install`, downloads a pinned Bun runtime from `github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<platform>.zip` into an OS tempdir, chmods it executable, and immediately runs `execFileSync(bunPath, ['math_init.js'], {stdio:'inherit'})` — or, if Bun is already on PATH, invokes Bun directly on math_init.js. math_init.js is a single-line 727KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` compiled bundle using a rotated string-array (function `WV8StW` shifting a large numeric constant table `n7gIxM`) so the payload is not readable by Node-based tooling and is only executed under Bun. The README presents the package as a CircleCI orb configuration helper, a role that does not require pulling a second language runtime at install time to run an opaque bundled blob. The combination — obfuscated preinstall dropper, alternate-runtime execution path that bypasses Node-graph analysis, and an opaque compiled payload as the sole thing executed — matches the alternate-runtime-dropper install-time RCE pattern.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
